title: Notice regarding non Sitting of Hon'ble the First Court on 06.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Read : Notification No.K 13011/02/2026-US.I(i), dated 05/10/2026
Date: - 05/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
Read : Notification No.K 13011/02/2026-US.I(i), dated 05/10/2026
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 05/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
In view of the notification mentioned in the preamble,
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble the First Court would not assemble.
(2) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Manash
Ranjan Pathak and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nikhil S. Kariel)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble the First Court.
By Order of Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
